outcome_statement: A requireKey-gated command queue lets this session remotely trigger already-built app actions (e.g. upload_recent_photos) on the founder's phone while the app is running, closing the last manual-tap gap after the one-time install and permission grants.
pain: Every Android driving action still needs a manual tap even after accessibility/biometric/photo permissions are granted -- no remote-trigger channel exists, unlike the browser extension.
value: Zero-tap driving after one-time device setup, matching the browser extension's already-proven poll/act/result pattern.
success_metrics: A real enqueue + claim + result round trip works end to end against the real DB
failure_metrics: A second poller could double-claim the same command (race condition)
constraints: Self-bootstrapping table, atomic claim (same claimed_at pattern as extension_drive_sessions)
unacceptable_result: Any change beyond the single command-queue route
